domainsCovered: Product checkout configuration (two parallel systems: legacy ProductCheckout JSON-blob vs canonical CheckoutProductPlan/CheckoutConfig graph)
Generic external/raw payment ingestion (Payment model, webhook-only)
Payment provider charge adapters (Stripe / Mercado Pago PIX / Mercado Pago Boleto)
Coupons (two parallel systems: workspace-scoped CheckoutCoupon vs product-scoped ProductCoupon)
Cart / social-lead abandonment recovery (two owners: kloel/CartRecoveryService vs checkout/CheckoutSocialRecoveryService)
Payout to seller bank accounts (BankAccount, ConnectPayoutService, MarketplaceTreasuryPayoutService)
Kloel SaaS subscription billing of merchants (billing/* — Stripe subscriptions, adjacent/separate domain)
Template marketplace (marketplace/MarketplaceService — NOTE: flow-template store, NOT money; mis-namespaced into this cluster)

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutProductPlan
canonicalEntities.role: Canonical checkout/plan resource (kind=PLAN|CHECKOUT). Parent of CheckoutConfig, OrderBump, Upsell, CheckoutOrder, CheckoutPlanLink, CheckoutSocialLead. priceInCents/currency live here.

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutPlanLink
canonicalEntities.role: Self-join linking a CheckoutProductPlan(checkout) to a CheckoutProductPlan(plan); models 'this checkout sells these plans' (primary/active flags, slug, referenceCode).

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutConfig
canonicalEntities.role: 1:1 visual+behavioral config for a plan (theme, payment-method toggles, coupon popup, timer, shipping, affiliate commission, pixels). ~70 typed columns.

canonicalEntities.name: OrderBump
canonicalEntities.role: Pre-payment add-on offer attached to a plan.

canonicalEntities.name: Upsell
canonicalEntities.role: Post-purchase one-click/new-payment upsell offer attached to a plan.

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutCoupon
canonicalEntities.role: Canonical workspace-scoped discount coupon (DiscountType, cents, appliesTo[]). Used by the CheckoutOrder pricing path.

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutPixel
canonicalEntities.role: Tracking pixel (Meta/GA) bound to a CheckoutConfig; event toggles.

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutOrder
canonicalEntities.role: Canonical checkout order: customer, totals in cents, coupon, bumps, status (OrderStatus), UTM, 1:1 CheckoutPayment, UpsellOrder[]. THE source of truth for checkout GMV.

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutPayment
canonicalEntities.role: 1:1 payment artifact for a CheckoutOrder: gateway, externalId, PIX/boleto/card detail, PaymentStatus, webhookData. NOT workspace-scoped (reached via order).

canonicalEntities.name: UpsellOrder
canonicalEntities.role: Accepted upsell line attached to a CheckoutOrder.

canonicalEntities.name: ProductCheckout
canonicalEntities.role: LEGACY checkout: single row per product with a 14-section JSON `config` blob + metrics. Superseded by CheckoutProductPlan+CheckoutConfig but still has live consumers (kloel chat tools, product-checkout.controller).

canonicalEntities.name: ProductCoupon
canonicalEntities.role: LEGACY/parallel product-scoped coupon (PERCENT/FIXED, Float). Managed by kloel/CouponService; synced into CheckoutCoupon via product-coupon-sync.util.

canonicalEntities.name: Payment
canonicalEntities.role: Generic raw payment record (provider, externalId, status, amount Float). Written ONLY by generic/Stripe webhook helpers; has no service of its own. Parallel to CheckoutPayment and KloelSale.

canonicalEntities.name: KloelSale
canonicalEntities.role: Chat-driven direct sale (lead/phone, amount Float, paymentLink, externalPaymentId). Source of truth for in-chat conversions. Parallel revenue silo NOT counted in CheckoutOrder GMV.

canonicalEntities.name: ExternalPaymentLink
canonicalEntities.role: Link to a sale on an external platform (hotmart/kiwify/eduzz/monetizze/braip) with totalSales/totalRevenue counters updated via webhook.

canonicalEntities.name: PhysicalOrder
canonicalEntities.role: Physical-goods fulfillment record (address, tracking, shipping). Loosely tied to a sale via saleId String? (no FK). Parallel to CheckoutOrder's own shipping/tracking columns.

canonicalEntities.name: KloelWallet
canonicalEntities.role: Per-workspace SELLER EARNINGS wallet (available/pending/blocked buckets, *InCents canonical + deprecated Float dual-write). Credited on paid checkout. Owned by kloel/WalletService.

canonicalEntities.name: KloelWalletTransaction
canonicalEntities.role: Mutable transaction rows for KloelWallet (type/amount/status/reference).

canonicalEntities.name: KloelWalletLedger
canonicalEntities.role: Append-only audit ledger for KloelWallet (direction/bucket/amountInCents/reason). Written via kloel/WalletLedgerService.appendWithinTx inside the same $transaction.

canonicalEntities.name: PrepaidWallet
canonicalEntities.role: Per-workspace PREPAID USAGE wallet (single balanceCents, autoRecharge, stripeCustomerId). Funds AI/WhatsApp/API usage. Owned by wallet/WalletService — a DIFFERENT class than KloelWallet's owner.

canonicalEntities.name: PrepaidWalletTransaction
canonicalEntities.role: Append-only TOPUP/USAGE/REFUND/ADJUSTMENT rows carrying balanceAfterCents (self-contained ledger; no separate ledger table).

canonicalEntities.name: BankAccount
canonicalEntities.role: Seller bank/PIX destination account for payouts (isDefault). Read by payout services.

canonicalEntities.name: WalletAnticipation
canonicalEntities.role: Receivable-anticipation record (fee%, net amount) against seller earnings. Float-based; adjacent to KloelWallet.

canonicalEntities.name: MarketplaceTreasury
canonicalEntities.role: Kloel's OWN house treasury per currency (available/pending/reserved cents). Distinct from per-seller KloelWallet/Connect balances. Owned by MarketplaceTreasuryService.

canonicalEntities.name: MarketplaceTreasuryLedger
canonicalEntities.role: Append-only ledger for the house treasury (direction/bucket/kind/orderId/feeSnapshotId).

canonicalEntities.name: MarketplaceFee
canonicalEntities.role: Versioned fee schedule (feeBps, fixed fee, volume tiers, activeFrom/To) feeding split/treasury math.

canonicalEntities.name: ConnectAccountBalance
canonicalEntities.role: Per-Stripe-Connect-account dual-balance (pending/available cents + lifetime counters) in Kloel's view. Materialized from ConnectLedgerEntry. Owned by LedgerService.

canonicalEntities.name: ConnectLedgerEntry
canonicalEntities.role: Append-only Connect ledger (CREDIT_PENDING/MATURE/DEBIT_PAYOUT/CHARGEBACK/REFUND/ADJUSTMENT) with balanceAfter snapshots + maturation schedule.

canonicalEntities.name: ConnectMaturationRule
canonicalEntities.role: Per-product/account-type delayDays controlling when pending Connect balance matures to available.

duplications.concept: Sale/Order/Payment record (the focal concern): Payment vs CheckoutPayment vs CheckoutOrder vs KloelSale
implementations: CheckoutOrder + CheckoutPayment (schema:3220/3330) — checkout pipeline source of truth
KloelSale (schema:1917) — chat-driven sales source of truth
Payment (schema:2744) — generic webhook-only raw payment, no owning service
PhysicalOrder (schema:2706) — physical fulfillment, saleId String? with no FK
duplications.canonicalChoice: CheckoutOrder+CheckoutPayment for product sales; KloelSale should become a thin originator that ALWAYS materializes a CheckoutOrder. Payment model should be retired (no service owns it).
duplications.note: DIVERGENT BEHAVIOR IN PROD: webhooks/payment-webhook-stripe.handlers.ts:44-54 fans a single Stripe event out to checkoutPayment + checkoutOrder + kloelSale via three separate updateMany() calls keyed on shared externalId. If any one row is missing/has a different externalId, that record silently never flips to PAID (see resolveExistingCheckoutPaymentForIdempotency divergence warn in checkout-payment.lifecycle.ts:170). The generic webhook (payment-webhook-generic.helpers.ts:79/111) updates kloelSale + payment but NOT checkoutOrder. Net effect: a sale can be PAID in one ledger and PENDING in another. Compounded by GMV double-source: admin gmv.query.ts:17 sums ONLY CheckoutOrder, so KloelSale chat revenue is invisible to platform GMV while merchant dashboard.service also reads only CheckoutOrder — KloelSale revenue is double-orphaned.

duplications.concept: Two distinct WalletService classes with the SAME name on DIFFERENT tables
implementations: kloel/wallet.service.ts:49 WalletService → KloelWallet/KloelWalletLedger (seller earnings, pending→available, withdraw)
wallet/wallet.service.ts:73 WalletService → PrepaidWallet/PrepaidWalletTransaction (usage credits, topup, debit)
duplications.canonicalChoice: Rename to SellerWalletService and PrepaidWalletService (or UsageWalletService). They are legitimately different domains but the identical class name is a maintenance trap and DI/import hazard.
duplications.note: Both are @Injectable, both named WalletService, both have confirm/credit/debit-style methods, both call MercadoPagoPixChargeService/StripeService. Easy to import the wrong one. KloelWallet still dual-writes deprecated Float columns (schema:1953) alongside *InCents per the P6-3 cutover comment — a live drift risk.

implementations: KloelWallet/KloelWalletTransaction/KloelWalletLedger (seller earnings) — kloel/WalletService + WalletLedgerService
PrepaidWallet/PrepaidWalletTransaction (usage prepaid) — wallet/WalletService
ConnectAccountBalance/ConnectLedgerEntry (Stripe Connect per-account) — payments/ledger/LedgerService
MarketplaceTreasury/MarketplaceTreasuryLedger (Kloel house balance) — MarketplaceTreasuryService
WalletAnticipation (Float receivable anticipation) — no dedicated service
duplications.canonicalChoice: Each represents a genuinely different actor's money (seller earnings vs prepaid usage vs connected-account vs house). Keep separate but extract ONE shared append-only ledger abstraction (direction/bucket/amountInCents/balanceAfter/reason + reconcile + maturation) instead of 3 near-identical hand-rolled implementations.
duplications.note: The append/reconcile/mature logic is re-implemented 3x with near-identical invariant comments (schema:1998-2005 vs 4375 vs 4459). ConnectLedgerEntry and PrepaidWalletTransaction carry balanceAfter snapshots; KloelWalletLedger and MarketplaceTreasuryLedger do not — inconsistent ledger contracts. WalletAnticipation is still Float-based while the others moved to BigInt cents.

duplications.concept: PIX charge creation against Mercado Pago
implementations: payments/mercadopago/mercadopago-pix-charge.service.ts:27 MercadoPagoPixChargeService (canonical, 10+ consumers)
checkout/mercado-pago-pix.service.ts:146 MercadoPagoPixService (ORPHAN — unregistered, only own specs import it)
duplications.canonicalChoice: MercadoPagoPixChargeService. Delete checkout/mercado-pago-pix.service.ts (+ its 2 spec files).
duplications.note: Both build the same MP /v1/payments PIX payload. The checkout/ one is not in checkout.module.ts and has no DI consumer — pure dead code carrying ~12KB of payload-building logic that can drift from the live one.

duplications.concept: Coupon / discount: workspace-scoped CheckoutCoupon vs product-scoped ProductCoupon
implementations: CheckoutCoupon (schema:3178, DiscountType enum, Int cents) — CheckoutCatalogService.validateCoupon, canonical for CheckoutOrder pricing
ProductCoupon (schema:2297, PERCENT/FIXED string, Float) — kloel/CouponService + ProductCouponDomainService
CheckoutConfig.autoCouponCode + couponPopup* fields (schema:3061) — a third coupon surface
duplications.canonicalChoice: CheckoutCoupon. ProductCoupon should be a write-through view that always upserts a CheckoutCoupon (the sync already exists one-way in product-coupon-sync.util.ts) — or be retired.
duplications.note: Two coupon tables with different scopes, value types (Int cents vs Float), and discount-type encodings ('FIXED'/'PERCENT' string vs DiscountType enum). product-coupon-sync.util.ts:mapProductCouponValueToCheckoutValue converts Float→cents on sync, so the same logical coupon exists twice with rounding-conversion between them — divergence risk if one is edited and sync doesn't fire.

implementations: kloel/cart-recovery.service.ts CartRecoveryService — @Cron 30min over CheckoutOrder status=PENDING, MIND-chosen email, stamps recoveryEmailSentAt
checkout/checkout-social-recovery.service.ts:46 CheckoutSocialRecoveryService — @Cron 10min over CheckoutSocialLead (CAPTURED/ENRICHED/ABANDONED)
duplications.canonicalChoice: Define a single Recovery domain that owns 'a buyer started but did not pay' regardless of whether they reached order-creation (CheckoutOrder PENDING) or only lead-capture (CheckoutSocialLead). Today the same human can be a PENDING CheckoutOrder AND a CheckoutSocialLead and get recovered twice by two crons on different cadences.
duplications.note: Two independent @Cron jobs, two channel-decision engines (MIND bandit/policy in cart-recovery vs deterministic workspaceChannels gate in social-recovery), two recovery-email templates (auth/email-templates/cart-recovery.html vs social-recovery.html), two sent-at stamps (CheckoutOrder.recoveryEmailSentAt vs CheckoutSocialLead.recoveryEmailSentAt/recoveryWhatsAppSentAt). No cross-dedup between them.

implementations: ProductCheckout (schema:2273) — single row, 14-section JSON config blob, own metrics; consumed by kloel chat tools + product-checkout.controller.ts
CheckoutProductPlan+CheckoutConfig+CheckoutPlanLink (schema:2969/3025/3005) — typed-column canonical graph
duplications.note: ProductCheckout's `config Json` duplicates ~70 typed CheckoutConfig columns as an untyped blob. Both still have live writers (kloel-product-sub-resource-tools.service.ts writes ProductCheckout; checkout-catalog-config.service.ts writes CheckoutConfig). Same conceptual 'how this product's checkout looks/behaves' stored two ways.

implementations: billing/stripe.service.ts:20 StripeService (+ billing/stripe-runtime.ts)
payments/stripe/stripe-charge.service.ts builds its own paymentIntents path
wallet/wallet.service.ts calls stripe.paymentIntents.create directly via injected StripeService
payments/connect/connect-payout.service.ts stripe.payouts.create
duplications.canonicalChoice: billing/StripeService as the single Stripe client factory; charge/payout/connect services should consume it, not re-derive config.
duplications.note: Multiple entry points to the Stripe SDK with separate config/runtime handling (billing/stripe-runtime.ts vs inline). Light redundancy, not behaviorally divergent today, but key/version drift surface.

implementations: ConnectPayoutService (payments/connect/connect-payout.service.ts:78) — stripe.payouts.create from Connect available balance
MarketplaceTreasuryPayoutService (marketplace-treasury-payout.service.ts:44) — payout from house treasury
kloel/WalletService.withdraw — withdraw from KloelWallet
duplications.canonicalChoice: Per-actor payout is legitimately distinct, but the debit-balance + append-ledger + create-payout sequence is reimplemented 3x and should share the ledger abstraction noted above.
duplications.note: Three withdrawal/payout flows with separate approval models (ConnectPayoutApprovalService two-step vs WalletAnticipation auto-complete vs treasury direct).

implementations: backend/src/marketplace/MarketplaceService — FlowTemplate catalog (NOT money)
backend/src/marketplace-treasury/* — house money treasury
split/marketplace fee math + MarketplaceFee model
duplications.canonicalChoice: Rename the FlowTemplate one to template-marketplace/TemplateMarketplaceService to stop colliding with the financial 'marketplace' (treasury/fees/split).
duplications.note: Pure naming entropy: 'marketplace' means both the flow-template store and the payments marketplace. Mis-leads cluster mapping and DI discovery.

legacyOrDead: checkout/mercado-pago-pix.service.ts:146 MercadoPagoPixService — ORPHAN: not registered in checkout.module.ts, only its own .spec files import it; superseded by payments/mercadopago/MercadoPagoPixChargeService.

Payment model (schema:2744 RAC_Payment) — no @Injectable owns it; written only by webhook helpers (payment-webhook-generic.helpers.ts:111, kloel-workspace-context-data.service.ts) and never aggregated into GMV. Effectively a vestigial raw-payment sink superseded by CheckoutPayment/KloelSale.
ProductCheckout model (schema:2273) — legacy JSON-blob checkout superseded by CheckoutProductPlan+CheckoutConfig; retains live writers via kloel chat tools, so 'transitional' rather than fully dead.
ProductCoupon model (schema:2297) — legacy product-scoped Float coupon superseded by CheckoutCoupon; kept alive only by one-way sync (product-coupon-sync.util.ts) and chat CouponService.

KloelWallet/KloelWalletTransaction Float columns (schema:1953-1955, 1973) — explicitly DEPRECATED per the P6-3 cutover comment; dual-written alongside *InCents pending a drop migration that has not landed.
WalletAnticipation (schema:2855) — Float-based receivable anticipation with no dedicated service; orphaned relative to the BigInt-cents ledger migration.
PhysicalOrder.saleId (schema:2733) — String? with no FK relation; dangling soft-link to a sale record that may live in CheckoutOrder OR KloelSale, with no integrity guarantee.
